create_dumpsys_thread: create a DumpsysThread instance with an AppScreenChecker to monitor Android app screen state asynchronously
check_user_exited: call check_user_exited on DumpsysThread to detect if the user has left the expected app screen
configure_check_frequency: configure DumpsysThread with a custom check_frequency to control how often dumpsys is called per loop iteration
set_max_failed_activity: set max_failed_current_activity on DumpsysThread to define consecutive failures before declaring user exit
review_dumpsys_thread: review the DumpsysThread class that runs async adb dumpsys checks via ThreadPoolExecutor to monitor Android screen state
